description: §14.8.9 S443 round 6b — assigning one tagged row onto another (a refresh in place) works and still strips: the client receives {id, name}.
rationale: Round 6 made the descriptor non-writable, so `Object.assign(a, b)` on two tagged rows threw a TypeError and the route answered 500 where base answered 200 stripped (review, measured). A legitimate program must not crash; the per-column markers are writable (the sink reads their presence) and non-configurable (cannot be removed).
